parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.
If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, obtain the value from the CasterId response parameter.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studio > Cloud Production Studio page to view the ID.

The name of the production studio in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。
如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台页面查看。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the component. If you added the component by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848030.html operation, obtain the value from the ComponentId response parameter
parameters.help_zh: 组件ID。如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848030.html添加导播台组件，请查看AddCasterComponent接口调用返回的参数ComponentId值
parameters.name: component_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the component. Default value: the component ID
parameters.name: component_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the component. Valid values:
text: text component. If this parameter is set to text, the TextLayerContent parameter is required.
image: image component. If this parameter is set to image, the ImageLayerContent parameter is required.
caption: translated caption component. If this parameter is set to caption, the CaptionLayerContent parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
组件的类型。取值：
text：文字组件。如果ComponentType的取值为text，TextLayerContent参数才必传。
image：图片组件。如果ComponentType的取值为image，ImageLayerContent参数才必传。
caption：翻译字幕组件。如果ComponentType的取值为caption，CaptionLayerContent参数才必传
parameters.name: component_type

parameters.help_en:
The display effect of the component. Valid values:

none (default): none.
animateH: horizontal scrolling.
animateV: vertical scrolling
parameters.help_zh:
组件显示的特效。取值：

none（默认值）：无。
animateH：水平滚动。
animateV：垂直滚动。
parameters.name: effect

parameters.help_en:
The size and layout information of the layer. The value is in JSON format. The elements are described as follows:
HeightNormalized: the normalized height ratio.
WidthNormalized: the normalized width ratio.
PositionNormalized: the normalized position of the layer element.
PositionRefer: the reference coordinates for the position of the element
parameters.help_zh:
Layer的尺寸，布局等信息。格式为JSON。设置元素说明如下：
HeightNormalized：高度归一化比例值。
WidthNormalized：宽度归一化比例值。
PositionNormalized：layer 元素的位置归一化值。
PositionRefer：元素的位置参考坐标值
parameters.name: component_layer

parameters.help_en:
The properties of the layer element. The value is in JSON format. The element properties are described as follows:
<notice>This parameter is required when the ComponentType parameter is set to text.
</notice>
SizeNormalized: the normalized font size. The font size is calculated by using the formula: font_size/output_height. Valid values: `[0,1]`. If the font size calculated by the system based on the normalization method is greater than 1024, the value 1024 is used.
BorderWidthNormalized: the normalized width of the text border. The normalized value is calculated based on the font size by using the formula: BorderWidth/FontSize. Valid values: `[0,1]`. If the value calculated by the system based on the normalization method is greater than 16, the value 16 is used. Default value: 0.
FontName: the font name. For valid values, see Production studio fonts. Default value: KaiTi.
BorderColor: the color of the text border. Valid values: `0x000000` to `0xffffff`. Default value: ``, which indicates that the parameter is invalid.
Text: the text content. Default value: ``.
Color: the text color. Default value: `0xff0000`, which indicates red
parameters.help_zh:
Layer元素属性。格式为JSON。元素属性说明如下：
<notice>当ComponentType取值为text时，本参数必传。
</notice>
SizeNormalized：字体归一化大小，字体设置大小为“font_size/output_height”，取值范围`[0,1]`，如果系统根据归一化方式反计算出来的字体大小大于1024，取1024。
BorderWidthNormalized：文字边框宽度归一化值，该归一化值是基于文字的size来计算的，即“BorderWidth/FontSize”，取值范围`[0,1]`，如果根据归一化方式反计算出来的值超过16，取16，默认0。
FontName：字体名称，取值请参见导播台字体说明，默认楷体，“KaiTi”。
BorderColor：文字边框色彩，取值“0x000000-0xffffff”，默认“”，表示无效。
Text：文本内容，默认“”。
Color：文字色彩，默认“0xff0000”，红色
parameters.name: text_layer_content

parameters.help_en:
The properties of the layer element. The value is in JSON format.
<notice>This parameter is required when the ComponentType parameter is set to image.
</notice>


MaterialId specifies the ID of the media asset
parameters.help_zh:
Layer元素属性。格式为JSON。
<notice>当ComponentType为image时，本参数必传。
</notice>


MaterialId为媒资库素材ID
parameters.name: image_layer_content

parameters.help_en:
The properties of the layer element. The value is in JSON format. The element properties are described as follows:
<notice>This parameter is required when the ComponentType parameter is set to caption.
</notice>
SizeNormalized: the normalized font size. The font size is calculated by using the formula: font_size/output_height. Valid values: `[0,1]`. If the font size calculated by the system based on the normalization method is greater than 1024, the value 1024 is used.
BorderWidthNormalized: the normalized width of the text border. The normalized value is calculated based on the font size by using the formula: BorderWidth/FontSize. Valid values: `[0,1]`. If the value calculated by the system based on the normalization method is greater than 16, the value 16 is used. Default value: 0.
FontName: the font name. For valid values, see Production studio fonts. Default value: KaiTi.
BorderColor: the color of the text border. Valid values: `0x000000` to `0xffffff`. Default value: ``, which indicates that the parameter is invalid.
LocationId: the channel ID of the translation source.
SourceLan: the original audio language of the video source. Valid values: en for English, cn for Chinese, es for Spanish, and ru for Russian. Default value: cn.
TargetLan: the target audio language of the video source. If this parameter is not specified, speech recognition is performed. If this parameter is specified, translation is performed. Valid values: en for English, cn for Chinese, es for Spanish, and ru for Russian.
ShowSourceLan: specifies whether to display the source language. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false.
Truncation: specifies whether the caption can be truncated. Valid values: true and false. Default value: false.
SourceLanPerLineWordCount: the number of words per line in the source language. This parameter takes effect only when the Truncation parameter is set to true. Default value: 20.
TargetLanPerLineWordCount: the number of words per line in the target language. This parameter takes effect only when the Truncation parameter is set to true. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
Layer元素属性。格式为JSON。元素属性说明如下：
<notice>当ComponentType为caption时，本参数必传。
</notice>
SizeNormalized：字体归一化大小，字体设置大小为“font_size/output_height”，取值范围`[0,1]`，如果系统根据归一化方式反计算出来的字体大小大于1024，取1024。
BorderWidthNormalized：文字边框宽度归一化值，该归一化值是基于文字的size来计算的，即“BorderWidth/FontSize”，取值范围`[0,1]`，如果根据归一化方式反计算出来的值超过16，取16，默认0。
FontName：字体名称，取值请参见导播台字体说明，默认楷体，“KaiTi”。
BorderColor：文字边框色彩，取值“0x000000-0xffffff”，默认“”，表示无效。
LocationId: 翻译源的channelId。
SourceLan: 视频源的原始音频语言。En-英文，cn-中文，es-西班牙文，ru-俄文，默认为cn-中文。
TargetLan：视频源的目标音频语言。不设置表示语音识别，设置表示翻译。取值：en-英文，cn-中文，es-西班牙文，ru-俄文，cn-中文。
ShowSourceLan：是否显示源语言。取值：true-显示，false-不显示，默认为false。
Truncation：字幕是否可以被截断。取值：true-可以被截断，false-不可以被截断，默认为false。
SourceLanPerLineWordCount：源语言每行字数，Truncation为true的时候生效， 默认20。
TargetLanPerLineWordCount：目标语言每行字数，Truncation为true的时候生效，默认20
